title: Render Plan Validator
description: Add RenderPlanLimits struct and validate_ui_node to framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, call validation before render_ui_node and render_component_scene, add unit test for oversized payloads.
summary: Added optional wasm32-wasip2 plugin builds via SEMIO_PLUGIN_WASIP2=1 (default remains wasm32-unknown-unknown with wasm-bindgen). Each plugin build now emits plugin-worker.js with manifest/createApp/handleCommand/render/destroy/tools/windowEngagements/windowMeasures message protocol. boot.ts loads plugins through isolated Web Workers when window.SEMIO_PLUGIN_WORKERS is true, with 5s message timeout that terminates and restarts the worker; otherwise falls back to direct module import.
